input: Create a chore reward chart just for myself

gold.taskTitle: Build a Personal Chore Reward Chart
gold.taskDescription: Create a self-directed chore reward chart that tracks personal household tasks and ties them to meaningful rewards.

questions.title: What format do you want the chart in?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a physical paper chart, a digital spreadsheet, an app, or something else.

questions.title: Which specific chores will go on the chart?
questions.description: Identify the exact chores the user wants to track, such as dishes, laundry, vacuuming, etc.

questions.title: How often do you want to reset the chart?
questions.description: Determine the cycle length — daily, weekly, monthly, or another interval.

questions.title: What is the reward system you have in mind?
questions.description: Understand how rewards are earned — points, stickers, checkmarks, streaks, or something custom.

questions.title: What rewards will you give yourself for completing chores?
questions.description: Find out what motivating rewards the user has in mind, such as treats, screen time, purchases, or experiences.

questions.title: Will all chores carry equal weight or point value?
questions.description: Determine if bigger or harder chores should earn more points or rewards than smaller ones.

questions.title: What is your main reason for making this chart?
questions.description: Understand the core motivation — building habits, managing anxiety, staying accountable, gamifying adulting, etc.
